leadText:
Flying Type (Japanese: VSゲノセクトII VS Genesect II), titled VS Genesect II in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 527th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the third chapter of the .

It is subtitled Genesect II (Japanese: フライング・インセクト Flying Insect) in the VIZ Media translation and Flying Type in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
